description: Essential TOEIC terms focusing on operational efficiency, professional development, and workplace rights.

nouns.example: The effectiveness of the new marketing campaign will be measured by sales growth.
We are looking for ways to improve the energy efficiency of our manufacturing plant.
The freight elevator is currently out of service for maintenance.
In case of an emergency, please use the stairs instead of the lift.

nouns.meaning: người làm chủ, chủ lao động
nouns.example: As an employer, the company is responsible for providing a safe working environment.
The terms of your employment are clearly stated in the contract.
The software engineer fixed the bug in the system within an hour.

nouns.meaning: công việc kỹ sư, ngành kỹ thuật
nouns.example: The firm specializes in civil engineering and urban planning.
This small enterprise has grown into a global leader in just five years.

nouns.meaning: quyền hạn, sự được phép hưởng
nouns.example: Your holiday entitlement increases after two years of service with the company.
The waiter recommended the grilled salmon as the best entrée on the menu.

adjectives.example: The new safety regulations will be effective starting from next Monday.

adjectives.meaning: năng suất cao, hiệu quả tốt
adjectives.example: An efficient filing system can save a lot of time in the office.
The community center offers various programs for elderly residents.
The manager was very enthusiastic about the new project proposal.

verbs.meaning: bắt đầu, dấn thân, lên tàu/máy bay
verbs.example: The company is about to embark on a major restructuring plan.
I must emphasize that all data in this report is strictly confidential.

verbs.meaning: cho phép, làm cho có thể
verbs.example: This software update will enable users to share files more easily.
Please find the invoice and the shipping label enclosed with this letter.
Managers are encouraged to provide regular feedback to their teams.

verbs.meaning: chịu đựng, tồn tại lâu dài
verbs.example: The company has managed to endure several economic recessions.
We need to enhance our customer service to compete in the current market.
The seminar aims to enlighten participants on new financial regulations.
Employees can enroll in the company’s retirement plan after six months.
Please double-check the figures to ensure accuracy in the final report.

adverbs.example: He communicates effectively with clients from diverse backgrounds.
The team worked efficiently to complete the task before the deadline.
The new policy was enthusiastically welcomed by most of the staff.
